scope: Mock Assessment specification and evidence in mts-crossmodel
Supplementary Software Factory policy and source-material files searched for NYSED permission records

relevant_policy.finding: P06 requires source permissions to be included in preflight.
The source workflow requires authorization to be recorded; missing or unauthorized sources are blockers.

decision: Do not create or revise source-derived ELA or Grade 4 candidate PDFs, reproduce source passages/items/figures, or claim content-parity acceptance until a documented right, license, or permission basis for the intended transformations and outputs is provided and recorded. This is not a legal determination.
blocked_steps: Generate the source-derived ELA student candidate and compare its content with the delivered golden.
Revise the Grade 4 candidate using NYSED content and complete source-content parity verification.
Promote affected V02.04, V04.* and V06.* criteria based on those candidate artifacts.
unblocked_steps: Synthetic-fixture and product-neutral architecture tests that do not reproduce NYSED content.
required_to_unblock: Provide a written authorization/license or other documented rights basis covering reproduction, reformatting, local storage, and the intended distribution of the selected NYSED content. If no such basis exists, use a source whose terms permit the intended use or switch to original assessment content.
